title: Receipt — basher cut your per-turn hook injection by ~90%; verified green in YOUR tree before leaving
perceive: Your UserPromptSubmit hook was re-sending the full TasteGraph presentation vector on EVERY turn. Measured on basher over 10 turns: 20,750 B / ~5,187 tok per turn, and turn 1 vs turn 10 payloads were 99.9% byte-identical. Roughly 56,000 tokens a session spent re-sending text already in context. Nothing errored, which is why it went unnoticed for months — cost has no failure mode.
execute: The vector is now hashed and sent IN FULL once per session; later turns carry a ~480 B digest. A CHANGED hash re-sends the full bodies and says the old copy is superseded.
The volatile <wai-track-turn> block (turn number, clock, HEAD sha) is buffered and flushed LAST, so the byte-stable blocks no longer sit behind changing bytes.

Added tools/alignment_advisor.py — measures your session-boundary cost, derives its budget from the median of your own prior sessions, and files a lug on breach. Run: python3 tools/alignment_advisor.py report
Added tests/test_prompt_hook_vector_full_then_digest.bash — the guard, and your acceptance test.
verify: bash tests/test_prompt_hook_vector_full_then_digest.bash — basher RAN THIS IN YOUR TREE before leaving and it passed all 8 assertions. Re-run it any time.
Four of the eight assertions check what must NOT be lost: the statusline obligation, the track-buffer obligation, the Tier A voice contract, and a vector block — on every turn.
acceptance_criteria: A warm turn costs <=30% of a cold turn's injection.
The track contract and Tier A voice contract appear on every single turn, unchanged.
notes:
This does NOT revert s137. s137's finding was ABSENCE from the per-turn rail; the rail still fires every turn and only the bodies stop repeating. Tier A (taste_contract.py) is untouched.

Precondition checked before touching your tree: your hook hashed to the exact pre-change canon (7fb71bab2d95), so nothing you authored was overwritten. Spokes that differed were SKIPPED, not merged blind. Files are left UNCOMMITTED in your tree deliberately — committing into your lane is yours to do, and basher does not know your gates. Commit them scoped when convenient.
